preregistration: C7 — does allocation capacity gate strategic demand?
frozen_before: any 4v4 policy is trained or any C7 rollout exists
motivated_by: artifacts/c6_stage1/C6_STAGE1_INFEASIBLE.json (e09bff7): offence vs contest r = -0.898 across 9 opponents

the_causal_hypothesis_under_test.measured_so_far: more offence trades against less contest across the tested roster (r = -0.898)
the_causal_hypothesis_under_test.interpretation: 2v2 appears to impose a tight team-allocation budget
the_causal_hypothesis_under_test.NOT_yet_proved: that this allocation constraint CAUSED the absence of reversals in C4 and C5
the_causal_hypothesis_under_test.what_C7_tests: exactly that causal step. C7 changes allocation capacity and asks whether response-ranking reversals appear.

held_fixed: episode-clustered bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 12345, LCB95 = q_0.025
the_manipulation.why_4v4_and_not_3v3: four agents permit genuinely simultaneous commitments -- carrier, escort, interceptor, home defender -- that cannibalise one another at 2v2. 3v3 leaves the same competition only slightly relaxed and would blur a negative.
the_manipulation.acknowledged_and_unavoidable_confound: opponent CONCEPTS are held fixed but their REALIZATION changes with team size: a BTProfile knob such as min_alive_for_defender=2 allocates a different fraction of a 4-agent team than of a 2-agent team. This is inherent to the manipulation and is recorded rather than papered over.

what_is_frozen_and_what_is_not.frozen_structural_prediction: If allocation capacity is the bottleneck, larger teams should permit mechanically simultaneous offence AND contest configurations that 2v2 could not.
explicitly_NOT_frozen: that 4v4 must produce any named strategy
that any response R1 should beat any R2
the direction, magnitude or identity of any reversal
which team allocation is 'correct' against any opponent
what_is_frozen_and_what_is_not.why: the reversal must be DISCOVERED by the scanner. C7 predicts a change in CAPACITY, never a winner.

stage_0_baseline_training.why_it_exists: the G0-V5 policies cannot act at 4v4 at all. Their observation encoder is hard-bound to 2 agents and raises 'grid must have shape (B, 2, 7, 20, 20)'. A 4v4 arm therefore requires its own baseline; there is no adapter that would not confound team size with out-of-distribution inference.
stage_0_baseline_training.what_is_trained: 3 seeds at 4v4, same architecture family, same reward, same opponent pool, same 1,000,000-step budget as G0-V5
stage_0_baseline_training.competence_gate: each seed must reach TASK_HEALTH PASS and SYSTEM_HEALTH PASS on the G0-V5 standard. A 4v4 arm that is merely incompetent would produce a NO_REVERSAL that says nothing about team size.
stage_0_baseline_training.gate_failure_action: if fewer than 3 of 3 pass competence, C7 STOPS before Stage 1 and the failure is reported as a training result, not a demand result
stage_0_baseline_training.estimated_cost: G0-V5 took ~6h50m per seed for 1M steps at 2v2; 4v4 steps are more expensive, so budget an overnight run for 3 seeds
stage_0_baseline_training.control_arm: the 2v2 arm reuses the EXISTING G0-V5 policies unchanged. No retraining, so the control is exactly the population C4/C5 measured.

stage_1_allocation_capacity.purpose: verify the manipulation did what it claims BEFORE asking about reversals. Engineering only, no reversal or utility claim.
stage_1_allocation_capacity.measures: the C6 Stage-1 measures unchanged: offensive_pressure, home_retention, red_contest_fraction from bt_red_role
stage_1_allocation_capacity.the_check: at 4v4, some opponent must achieve an offence+contest sum EXCEEDING the maximum observed at 2v2 (0.885, OP7). If the sum ceiling does not rise, allocation capacity did not expand and the treatment is inert.
stage_1_allocation_capacity.also_measured_descriptively: the offence-vs-contest correlation at 4v4, to be compared against the 2v2 r = -0.898
stage_1_allocation_capacity.fail_action: if capacity did not expand, C7 STOPS at Stage 1 and reports that team size did not relax the budget. Stage 2 is not run and its block is not spent.
stage_1_allocation_capacity.hard_boundary: once Stage 2 begins, no policy, profile or measure may change.

stage_2_reversal_discovery.scanner: the C5 gated parallel scanner, reused unchanged
stage_2_reversal_discovery.why_both_arms: C4 and C5 scanned 2v2 under different seed blocks and partitions. Re-scanning 2v2 here with the identical protocol makes the comparison internal to C7 rather than across experiments.
stage_2_reversal_discovery.primary_comparison: does a replicated reversal exist at 4v4 that does not exist at 2v2, under one identical protocol

stage_3_confirmation.rule: tests only the single top-ranked Stage-2 candidate, under the identical criterion, with no search

C7_CAPACITY_GATES_DEMAND.condition: a replicated reversal is found at 4v4 and confirmed on 9930000, AND no such reversal is found at 2v2 under the identical protocol
C7_CAPACITY_GATES_DEMAND.establishes: allocation capacity gates the existence of strategic demand on this map
C7_CAPACITY_GATES_DEMAND.does_not_establish: routability. The already-frozen observability test remains mandatory before any oracle training.
C7_CAPACITY_GATES_DEMAND.next: observability test on a fresh block, then the existing oracle / crossover / latent pipeline

C7_NO_REVERSAL_AT_4V4.condition: capacity expanded at Stage 1 but no replicated reversal is found at 4v4
C7_NO_REVERSAL_AT_4V4.meaning: team size is NOT the missing ingredient. The allocation-budget hypothesis is disconfirmed as the binding constraint.
C7_NO_REVERSAL_AT_4V4.action: STOP enlarging teams. Do not try 6v6 or 8v8 -- that would be the same iterate-until-it-passes pattern the pipeline exists to prevent. The next suspect becomes the MACRO/ACTION REPRESENTATION or the objective structure, under its own preregistration.
C7_NO_REVERSAL_AT_4V4.value: this is a highly informative negative and is explicitly not a failed experiment

C7_CAPACITY_DID_NOT_EXPAND.condition: Stage 1 shows no rise in the offence+contest ceiling at 4v4
C7_CAPACITY_DID_NOT_EXPAND.meaning: the manipulation was inert; nothing is learned about demand
C7_CAPACITY_DID_NOT_EXPAND.action: STOP. Stage 2 block remains unspent. Diagnose the environment or opponent realization before any further team-size work.

C7_BASELINE_INCOMPETENT.condition: fewer than 3 of 3 Stage-0 seeds clear the competence gate
C7_BASELINE_INCOMPETENT.meaning: a training result, not a demand result
C7_BASELINE_INCOMPETENT.action: STOP before Stage 1. Do not scan an incompetent baseline.

prohibited: preregistering which response should win at either team size
reusing C6's unspent blocks for C7
adjusting delta, support minima, replication or the ranking function
modifying any existing OP5-OP12 profile or any G0-V5 checkpoint
training an oracle before the observability test
claiming a task-outcome tradeoff from a carrier_survival screen proxy
citing the 2v2 allocation budget as the demonstrated CAUSE of C4/C5 -- it is a measured correlation plus an argument until C7 says otherwise
immutability: After any Stage-1 number exists, none of the above may change.
